## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 12-fascicle Táng Tiāntái-school sub-commentary on [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Dà bān niè pán jīng shū* 大般涅槃經疏 ([KR6g0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0007), T1767) is by [行滿](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A1%8C%E6%BB%BF) Xíngmǎn. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X660).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (766–800) reflects Xíngmǎn's mid-Táng activity. The work parallels Dàoxiān's *Sī jì* ([KR6g0018](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0018), X661).
